claims.statement: my-little-skills is a curated Agent Skills and plugin marketplace for Codex/OpenAI, Claude Code, Claude and Cowork.
pr-creator is distributed only as developer-workflow-skills:pr-creator, and humanize-korean requires explicitly installing writing-skills.
Offline product-context commands start no LLM, OpenWiki, network request or background job; a current result is not release approval.
Wiki updates use the subscription-authenticated host session with no API-key fallback, and the default work budget is three pages including quickstart.

The plugin README says product-context-skills is installable from the my-little-skills marketplace, and that root skills/product-context is canonical with the plugin copy as its exact distribution mirror.

MCP setup is an explicit per-machine step requiring Python 3.10+, Node.js 22.22+, npm and subscription logins, installing a pinned OpenWiki 0.9.0 runtime under ~/.local/share/product-context/<runtime-version> taken from runtime/package.json; existing custom workflows are preserved and block generation.

The product-aware product_setup.py completion report has three separate rows (local installation, product PR configuration, actual PR publication); complete requires all three and unknown means inspection was unavailable, not that a credential is absent.
visual-explainer is bundled in design-skills for Claude Code and Codex, and its upstream record pins v0.15.0 with original MIT notices.
Maintainer-authored skills listed in LICENSING.md are MIT licensed, while imported skills and assets retain their own licenses and attribution.
